title: Name Descriptors
html:
The last word on green and better gear is the Superior postfix. That word is how you read Strength, Agility, Endurance, and Intellect at a glance. A fighter tank looking for Endurance hunts Beetle plate. The same word on a different weapon family can mean something else — armor Hippo is not mace Hippopotamus.

Blue and purple add a word in front. Yellow can add another word before this last word. Those lists are on Magic Prefixes, Unique Prefixes, and Rare Postfixes. Rainbow endings are on Mythic Suffixes.

Armor

Any class can wear any armor that meets the level. The last word still comes from that armor's class list.

Fighter

  • Beetle — + Endurance
  • Hippo — + Strength
  • Penguin, Ant, Liger — + Strength, + Endurance
  • Tigon, Panda, Tarantula — + Strength, + Agility

Ranger

  • Hawk — + Agility
  • Greyhound — + Endurance
  • Manatee, Newt, Bonobo — + Agility, + Endurance
  • Dragonfly, Squid, Blowfish — + Agility, + Intellect

Mage

  • Noggin' — + Intellect
  • Turtle — + Endurance
  • Starfish, Armadillo, Unicorn, Wallaby — + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Narwhal — + Agility, + Intellect (ninja mage body only, not random drops)

Weapons

Melee

Maces

  • Snapper — + Endurance
  • Bunny — + Agility, + Endurance
  • Hog — + Strength, + Endurance
  • Buckaroo — + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Hippopotamus — + Agility, + Strength

Staves

  • Platypus — + Intellect
  • Wombat — + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Beaver — + Strength, + Endurance, + Intellect

Picks

  • Taint — + Strength
  • Hysteria — + Agility, + Endurance
  • Rage — + Strength, + Endurance
  • Battle — + Strength, + Endurance, + Intellect

Swords

  • Bovine — + Agility
  • Muskrat — + Agility, + Intellect
  • Nutria — + Strength, + Intellect
  • Monkey — + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect

Axes

  • Rendezvous Point — + Agility
  • Reactor — + Strength
  • Party — + Agility, + Endurance
  • Ghetto — + Strength, + Endurance
  • Nether Region — + Agility, + Strength
  • Flipside — + Strength, + Agility, + Intellect

Ranged

Crossbows

  • Sugar Glider — + Agility
  • Roadkill — + Endurance
  • Ladybug — + Agility, + Intellect
  • Gerbil — + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Wasp — + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect

Guns

  • Yeti — + Agility
  • Termite — + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Spammer — + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect

Cannons

  • Jumbo Shrimp — + Agility
  • Elephant — + Endurance
  • Brontosaurus — + Strength
  • Whale — + Agility, + Endurance
  • Rhino — + Endurance, + Intellect (same word as jewelry Rhino, different stats)
  • Kraken — + Agility, + Intellect
  • Python — + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect

Jewelry

Rings and amulets share this list, except Chicken, which is amulet-only.

  • Crocodile — + Endurance
  • Sasquatch — + Strength
  • Jackalope — + Agility
  • Dodo — + Intellect
  • Clam — + Strength, + Endurance
  • Llama — + Agility, + Endurance
  • Chicken — + Agility, + Endurance (amulets only)
  • Amoeba — + Agility, + Strength
  • Donkey — + Agility, + Intellect
  • Rooster — + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Rhino — + Strength, + Intellect
  • Chinchilla — + Strength, + Agility, + Endurance
  • Butterfly — + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Lobster — + Strength, + Endurance, + Intellect
  • Goat — + Agility, + Intellect, + Strength
  • Algae — + Strength, + Agility, + Endurance, + Intellect

The full dump of every other name word is on the category pages linked from Modifiers.
